standard.summary: 实验性窗口注意力。auto 会优先尊重启动器/预检解析后的 attention
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Experimental windowed attention. auto defers to the attention resolved by the launcher or preflight
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 实验性窗口注意力。auto 会优先尊重启动器/预检解析后的 attention backend；不支持窗口实现时再 fallback。

advanced_en.principle: Experimental window attention. auto first respects the attention backend resolved by the launcher/preflight, then falls back when a windowed implementation is unavailable.
